notes.title: Enabling Cloud saves
notes.notes:
Hi Vangers!

Important announcement, please read till the end.

Starting February 1st, we will enable Cloud saves.
This will enable automatic save-files transfers between all you steam-connected devices

However, if you are playing the game from different devices and have separate set of save files, Steam will ask you to choose between those sets (you CAN NOT save both save files sets automatically!).

There are two possible solutions to resolve save file conflicts.

1. Copy current saves to a safe place.
Go to Steam, go to the library, right-click on the game Vangers, select the "Manage" menu item, select "Browse local files" go to the data/savegame/ folder and copy all save files to some other folder.

2. Disable cloud synchronization.
Go to Steam, go to settings, select cloud, and disable the first option "Enable Steam cloud".
At the same time, if you used Cloud saves in other games, they will also be disabled.

3. Turn off cloud saves for the Vangers only. (This option will appear only after Feb 1st)
Open Steam, go to the library, right-click on the Vangers game, select the menu item 'Properties', turn off the 'Cloud Saves' switch.

If you are concerned that you may have save conflicts, do one of these steps before the end of January.

Good Luck on the Road!

notes.title: 25th Anniversary of the Vangers Release
notes.notes:
Dear Wild Wheelers!
Vangers have turned [b]25 years old[/b] on June 19th.

Hundreds of thousands monades passed through the [b]Infernal Conveyor[/b] during these years. Not to say how much Cirt was collected - it's unthinkable!

In an amazing way [b]Creature Soup[/b] went beyond the UniVang Universe and all of us have been boiling inside it for a quarter of a century, mutating and evolving.

On many people the game has made an irreversible impact, but the fans have made an impact on it as well: they researched and improved the game, and created lots of unique art pieces.
And these processes are still going strong. [i]The Soup is boiling![/i]

Well!
Cheers to the devs who created this crazy splendor! ✨
Cheers to the gamers and the Community for the game’s longevity 💫

Take care of Your Self, Your Mechoses and Your eLeeches 🐛
[b]Happy Anniversary to all of us! [/b]🍾🍾🍾

notes.title: Spring BugFix
notes.notes:
Hey Wheeler, the Spring has come!
To make sure your adventures in the Chain of Worlds are free from any hindrances we’ve captured and destroyed a bunch of Bugs. 
See you on the bumpy roads of the Univang!

[b]List of changes:[/b]
💠 Video fixes for MacOS
💠 Fixes for memory issues
💠 Prevented infinite loop when handing out eLeech if Eleerection is the only cycle left
💠 Prevented "permanent" UI block after using Boot Sector
💠 Window aspect ratio now calculated dynamically
💠 Fixed game crash when trying to use Protractor under some circumstances
💠 Error messages are more informative in certain cases
💠 Fixed game crash when window height is less than 600
💠 Prevented unwanted mouse cursor position changes in certain cases
💠 Fixed texts alignment for game ending screens and items with associated text screens (tabutasks, passengers, poponkas)
💠 Multiple fixes for game chat in multiplayer: init scroll position, alignment, size at different resolutions
💠 Fixed multiplayer chat closing upon any attempts to type
💠 Fixed multiple errors in Mechosoma game mode on Necross
💠 Multiple changes to make working with code easier

notes.title: Vangers: Now in HD!
notes.notes:
Today on 22.02.22 an update which was anticipated by many Wheelers shall be released:
the game now supports 1280х720 resolution!

[b]How to activate:[/b]
Options -> Graphics -> Screen: one click and you’re good to go!

These days game's code is published as [i]Open Source[/i] and the development is driven by enthusiasts from the game’s Community. A few years ago Nikita “lpenguin” Pryanichnikov created an HD patch, which was refined by joint efforts with the author and so now we can add the resulting upgrade to the official version of the game.
Hurrraaaaay!

[b]List of changes:[/b]
1) after HD activation you can see world's surface in full screen. Special expanded borders were added for Menu and escaves;
2) Now you can see original arts while traveling through Passages;
3) Stability of Multiplayer mode was significantly improved.
[i]Yes, we do play Vangers online![/i]
4) A lot of bugs was fixed too;
5) Credits in the Menu were updated: now you can discover the names of Community members who have been improving the game over the last years.

[b] Known Issues [/b]
After activation of HD the oxygen bar may be partially overlapped by parts of interface so you won’t see how much you have left. You may use F1 by default to turn off the interface.
This will be fixed in the next updates.

Leave your feedback and emotions in comments!
Do not forget that [i]Open Source[/i] lets you join the game's development.

notes.title: Halloween comes to the Chain of the Worlds
notes.notes:
Wanna get a new perspective on the old familiar Chain of the Worlds, wheelers? You’ve got exactly a week to do so.

It all began just a bit over 10 days ago with a simple phrase: “[i]How about we replace all the raffa with pumpkins for Halloween?[/i]” but it sure didn’t end there!

[list]
[*] Each mechos now has a brand-new Halloween-themed model
[*] Same goes for most of the weapons
[*] Color palettes of menus and worlds have been swapped for extra spookiness
[*] All the music tracks have been replaced with their covers or with new tracks from the community
[*] Spiders have taken over the ecosystem, supplanting the beebs
[*] You can now greet fellow vangers with a honk! Press [b]H[/b] to do so
[*] Some other things have been changed – prepare yourselves for surprises! 
[/list]
 
Game balance has not been affected by these changes, and you can keep playing with your preexisting savefiles.

This modification has been made by a small team from Russian Vangers Community to amuse the wild hearse-riders and to let them have some fun. Could you imagine a better time to misbehave a bit than Halloween? ^__^
We’ll be happy to hear what you think about the mod ;)
[u]And the game will be back to normal by the end of the day of November, 2nd.[/u]

notes.title: IMPORTANT NOTICE: Upcoming update
Remembering Vangers And The Virtue Of Nonsense
notes.notes:
Be a good vanger and take the nymbos to Incubator, would you? Grab a jar of phlegma while you re there – the Podish bunch are due a good smearing. Maybe snap up a tabutask or two if you think your mechos can take it. What s that you got? An Oxidise Monk? Pfft. Still, if it s Plump-Up, you might try and run an Eleerection – though take care of that eLeech, vanger. They might just be reincarnated pod-eaters who plumped-out to death, but they still deserve better than to cark it in the back of some rattletrap raffa driven by some know-nothing rambler who crumples into the first stinker he sees. And if you don t win Eleerection you aren t ever going to reach Glorx, much less anywhere else in the Chain.

If you understood that, then you probably already have some idea why Vangers – re-released on Steam and GOG last year – is one of the oddest, most original and overlooked games in history. If you didn t understand it then you are in the position everyone else was in June of 1998, bewildered by their purpose in a gameworld designed to be explicitly, unintelligibly alien in almost every respect.
